steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: (Blows) Let me massage it a little. Does it still hurt?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh no, ${PlayerName}. How could they do that to you, even I've never beaten you up like this... Why did you have to provoke them?
You want to say it looks worse than it feels, but it's rare to see these two look so worried about you...

options: How did you guys find me?

steps.content: It's not an easy route from the central elevator to here.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Just like Chief can locate Sinners with the shackles, we can sense your presence too.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Although it was very faint, I heard your call on the other end of the shackles.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's all thanks to the shackles that I could come back to your side.
Her voice is still so calm and expressionless. Meanwhile, the Nightmare floats to your side and rubs at your gently.
